facts.text: W Maldives is a private island resort in North Ari Atoll, set on a house reef.
facts.excerpt: Located in the breathtaking North Ari Atoll, our Maldives private island resort is set atop one of the best house reefs in the Maldives

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says Fesdu has one of the best house reefs of the resort islands, with dive and snorkel spots right off the beach.
facts.excerpt: Fesdu has one of the best 'house reefs' of all the resort islands, which means spectacular dive and snorkel spots right off the beach, as opposed to the boat rides often required elsewhere.

facts.text: Overwater villas have their own private pool.
facts.excerpt: Dip and splash in your Maldives overwater villa with a pool exclusively for you

facts.text: Each overwater bungalow has direct access to the house reef.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy direct access to one of the best house reefs from each of our Maldives overwater bungalows

facts.text: The beach villas take their design cues from the island's mangroves and sit steps from the sand.
facts.excerpt: Our Maldives beach villas channel the raw beauty of the island’s lush mangroves

facts.text: A two-bedroom beachfront villa has a private pool, an open-air balcony and its own slide.
facts.excerpt: complete with two bedrooms (1 King, 2 Queen beds), a private pool, open-air balcony, and your very own slide into the fun.

facts.text: AWAY Spa has private overwater treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: our expert Maldives spa therapists bring the bliss in private treatment rooms above the turquoise blue.

facts.text: Guests can snorkel the house reef on a tour with the resident marine biologist.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a spectacular snorkelling tour of our resort’s house reef with our resident marine biologist.

facts.text: Reef sharks and turtles can be found just off the resort.
facts.excerpt: reef sharks and turtles await just beyond the doorstep of our Maldives luxury resort.

facts.text: Guided jet-ski tours go to nearby uninhabited islands.
facts.excerpt: venture to the nearby uninhabited islands with a guided jet-ski tour on our Wave Runner Jet Ski

facts.text: Gaathafushi is a small private island near the resort that guests can book, including for a romantic overnight stay.
facts.excerpt: Book it for the perfect proposal, a romantic overnight stay in a villa under the stars

facts.text: SIP is an overwater cocktail bar with a Peruvian atmosphere and Nikkei bites.
facts.excerpt: End your day with breathtaking sunsets at SIP, our overwater cocktail bar in the Maldives with a vibrant Peruvian atmosphere, inventive cocktails and fresh Nikkei bites.
switch it up with an overwater seafood dinner at FISH

facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever team can arrange a speedboat ride to a private beach with a sunset dinner for two.
facts.excerpt: A luxury speedboat ride to a private beach with a sunset dinner for two?

facts.text: English is spoken by all staff.
facts.excerpt: English is spoken by all talents at W Maldives.

facts.text: Return seaplane transfers from Velana International Airport are mandatory and charged separately.
facts.excerpt: Mandatory return seaplane transfers are charged separately

facts.text: Drones may not be flown on or above the island by the general public.
facts.excerpt: W Maldives prohibits the operation of unmanned aerial systems or drones, on or above the island by the general public

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the groove is younger than at other resorts, with water sports encouraged.
facts.excerpt: The groove here is younger than at other resorts, so water sports and other feats of athleticism by the beach are encouraged.
